RANK: CURV-RESID-CONTRAST | position=1 | reason=E6/E7 show the failure is at depth (gold prefix alive 0.068 at depth 4, l1_br T4 NLL 9.03 while resample reaches 0.0636), and E5 shows the successor contrast is strongly measurable (top-1 mass 0.438 to 0.054 across entropy bins), so spending curved residual capacity on the successor-vs-null direction at the mild scale s=0.9/max||z|| targets exactly the deeper-token capacity that dies, with the contrast gain inside the quantizer argmin and exp-map composition (real coupling, no auxiliary loss).
RANK: BCGR-LORENTZ | position=2 | reason=It is the only proposal that removes the radial part from the residual, which matches E6/E7 where the radius-heavy hyperbolic l1_br scores 0.0467 against 0.0621 for its Euclidean control, and E5's heterogeneous support (2.77 vs 44.3 successors) justifies its alpha-shrunk, codeword-radius-scaled displacement that vanishes to the exact baseline for noisy items; complete equations, explicit clamps, ~1-2% cost.
RANK: GYROFRAME-RQ | position=3 | reason=Its PMI successor contrast is the signal the evidence backs, and the moving-frame transport is a genuine curved operation inside the quantizer, but a constant radius-1 pole applies full-strength displacement to the 4895 low-support items (mean support 2.77, E5) and stretches the residual toward norm 2, risking the reconstruction degradation that the l1_br failure at 0.0467 (E6) illustrates; no shrinkage is offered against that risk.
RANK: GYROFRAME-RQ__ideation_4 | position=4 | reason=Same moving-frame/gyro-translation coupling as GYROFRAME-RQ with the same PMI evidence, but its decisive constants rho and sigma are only "measured once and frozen" with equations deferred to an absent SPEC section, and it needs a 75 MB d=768 buffer; nothing in E5-E13 distinguishes it from its better-specified sibling, so it ranks below it.
RANK: CONFORMAL-SUCC-RQ | position=5 | reason=Its behaviour scalar is successor concentration, and E6 already contains a successor_entropy arm at recall 0.0512 versus 0.0621 for l1_br_euclid, i.e. the closest measured analogue underperformed; moreover responsibility-averaging g_i into per-code g_l,k collapses the item-specific contrast into a near-constant per-code distance rescale, which is the radial/reweighting kind of manipulation E6/E7 show to be uninformative.
